- Preserve migration provenance: source/target schema versions, migration-tool version, and transformation chain. Migration-test failures block release.
- Preserve exact interval constraints and solver version; also check whether solver timeout/“unknown” is distinguished from proven infeasibility and whether diagnostics are retained.
